text_block_list.text: We're at the autumn Tenno Sho and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's on the up and up, and people's

expectations for her continue to rise.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Нарита Брайан's poor health
persists and
people are beginning to
lose faith in her. Hishi
Amazon feels that
the only thing she can do is
wait for her
to recover.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
During an interview before the Japan
Cup, Hishi
Amazon declares to everyone
that her rival is
Нарита Брайан, and Narita
Brian alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's adamant that her rival will make a

comeback. The conviction rubs off on
the public,
restoring some of their faith.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
